# GraphQL.js parser subset

Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/graphql/v/17.0.2

This directory contains the unmodified CommonJS files transitively required by
`graphql/language/parser.js` from GraphQL.js 17.0.2, plus its MIT license.
The package manifest retains the upstream metadata and exposes only this entry.
Type declarations, source maps, and unrelated modules are omitted.
